rows.question: What is the admission fee and is it refundable?
rows.answer: The admission fee is Rs 30,000 [1]. It is non-refundable [2].

rows.question: What is the tuition fee per credit hour for BS students?
rows.answer: The tuition fee per credit hour for BS students is Rs. 12,000 [1].

rows.question: How much is the Student Activities Fund per semester?
rows.answer: Students contribute Rs 2,500 towards the Student Activities Fund per semester [1].

rows.question: What is the fee for retaking a final exam per course?
rows.answer: The fee for retaking a final exam per course/lab is Rs. 2,000 [1].

rows.question: How much does a campus transfer cost?
rows.answer: The campus transfer fee is Rs. 5,000 [1].

rows.question: What percentage of fee is refunded if I withdraw by the 10th day of classes?
rows.answer: If you withdraw by the 10th day of the commencement of classes, 100% of the tuition fee is refunded [1].

rows.question: When can I submit my admission application for 2026?
rows.answer: You can submit your admission application for 2026 between May 20 (Wed) and June 30 (Tue) [1].

rows.question: When is the merit list for undergraduate programs announced?
rows.answer: The merit list for undergraduate programs is announced on July 22 (Wed) [1].

rows.question: When do classes commence for new admissions?
rows.answer: Classes for new admissions commence on August 17 [3], [5].

rows.question: How do I apply for admission and can I apply by post?
rows.answer:
To apply for admission, follow these steps:

1. Fill out the Admission Application Form online [1], [2].
2. Note the unique Application Reference Number (ARN) assigned by the system [1], [2].
3. Ensure all information entered is correct to avoid cancellation of admission [1], [2].
4. Deposit the Application Fee at the designated bank [1].
5. Print your Admit Card after payment [1].
6. Visit the test campus on the date and time specified on your Admit Card [1], [4].

Applications received through post or by hand will not be accepted or entertained [1], [2].

rows.question: What is the ARN given during the application?
rows.answer: The online system assigns a unique Application Reference Number (ARN) to each applicant, which must be noted for later use [1], [2].

rows.question: When do Fall 2026 classes start?
rows.answer: The first day of classes for Fall 2026 is Monday, 17 August 2026 [1].

rows.question: When are the Sessional I exams in Fall 2026?
rows.answer: The Sessional I exams for Fall 2026 are scheduled from 19 September 2026 to 23 September 2026 [1].

rows.question: Are there on-campus hostels for female students?
rows.answer: No, on-campus hostels are for male students only [1]. Female students should refer to the external hostels list for private accommodation options [1].

rows.question: By what time must boarders be back in the hostel?
rows.answer: Boarders must be back in the hostel by 11:00 PM [1], [2].

rows.question: What is the rent of Durrani Hostel?
rows.answer: The rent for Durrani Hostel is 7000 [1].
